decision: held: the record's principal positive source, 18844328 (Mori 2009 MCI trial, Phytother Res), has no open full text; its abstract gives the design and regimen, but Dr. Pham explicitly requires verified methods for it. The two open acute trials are approved without credit (one mixed, one null on its primary composite).
summary: 18844328 abstract: 30 Japanese adults aged 50-80 with MCI, 4 x 250 mg tablets (96% Yamabushitake powder) three times daily for 16 weeks, HDS-R scores higher than placebo at weeks 8-16 and falling after stopping. 38140277 (40 healthy adults, single 1 g dose) showed selected task improvements, and 40276537 (18 healthy adults, single 3 g extract) found no effect on the primary global cognitive composite. Dementia-treatment and neurogenesis inference stays rejected; the record stays held.
